title: 第15章 不坑你们坑谁第16章 上古圣药渡劫神莲
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
毫无疑问，天剑宗之人逃不过问心境的考验。
天剑宗弟子齐齐高喊，“我们想干掉太一宗，我们想拿到真灵！”
几十个人同时高喊，声音响彻云霄。
这野心赤裸裸地喊出来，太一宗弟子愣住了，周边之人更是目瞪口呆。
段则然当场就发飙了，“天剑宗欺人太甚，想陷害我们，那就等着我们的报复吧，兄弟们，干他们。”
太一宗作为南境五大宗门之首，向来心高气傲，什么时候受过这样的鸟气，一个个怒气冲天，纷纷拔剑。
天剑宗没想到事情变成这样，但面对暴躁的段则然，面对太一宗的怒火，他们除了应对，根本辩解不了。
寻宝还没开始，就迎来莫名其妙的一场大战。
林子里乱作一团，刀剑声，嘶吼声，惨叫声，交织成一道美妙的乐章。
就在两宗打得不可开交的时候，隆隆的声音滚滚而来，几百只妖兽瞬间围了过来，距离他们不过几百丈距离了。
“该死的，都是你们天剑宗，把这些妖兽引来了。”
段则然心急如焚，这可是几百只啊，怎么办？
“大师兄别打了，快服用避兽丹。”
一名太一宗弟子大喊。
面对汹涌的妖兽大军，两宗弟子都傻了眼。
这么多妖兽，要灭起来不容易，估计得大战到天黑了，到时候真灵都便宜其他人了。
不少弟子拿出避兽丹，准备服用。
段则然也拿出避兽丹，一眼却瞥见对面的云星落气息浑然天成，几乎和森林融为了一体。
再看他们的避兽丹，散发着浓烈的气息，让妖兽避之不及。
段则然终于相信了之前云星落所说的，隐息丹确实有效果，他一声大喊，“不能用，用了真灵也会避开我们的。”

关键时刻，云星落现身了，手上拿着隐息丹，“太一宗的各位道友，可需要隐息丹？”
没有时间考虑了，段则然直接开口，“多少钱一粒？”
“一千，中品灵石，不议价。”
“你刚才只卖一百块下品灵石呢？”
“刚才是刚才，现在是现在，你可以不买。”
“给给给。”
来不及了，太一宗每个人掏出灵石，快速购买之后捏碎丹药，涂抹在自己的身上。
只是片刻之间，太一宗三十多人的气息瞬间就和森林融为一体。
天剑宗之人看慕了，苏芫芫厚着脸皮问，“还有吗，我们也要。”
“有，但不卖给你们。”
云星落果断拒绝。
苏芫芫瞬间恼怒，“云星落，你还是不是人，你设局陷害我们，现在在这里高价做生意，又拒绝卖给我们，你还有没有点道德？”
云星落看着苏芫芫厚颜无耻的样子，讥笑一声，“苏芫芫，你们有时间在这里道德绑架，还是想想怎么应对眼前的妖兽吧。”
此时，妖兽已经到了眼前。
太一宗之人身上的气息被隐藏了，它们直接朝着天剑宗弟子冲了过来。
“都是你，搞什么不好，非得去杀云星落，现在好了，搬起石头砸自己的脚。”
陆承舟有些烦躁，这苏芫芫惹谁不好，惹云星落那个煞星，弄得现在他们很被动，他恨死这个惹祸精了。
好在肖鹤果断，立马吩咐道，“好了别吵了，赶紧服下避兽丹，不然来不及了。”
天剑宗之人都不是傻子，知道自己被人反坑了。
但是现在他们时间耗不起，纷纷服下避兽丹。

这时候，云星落再次隐身跑远了。
content_en:
There is no doubt that people from the Tianjian Sect cannot escape the test of their state of mind.
The disciples of Tianjian Sect all shouted, "We want to kill Taiyi Sect, we want to get the true spirit!"
Dozens of people shouted at the same time, and their voices echoed through the sky.
The disciples of Taiyi Sect were stunned when this ambition was shouted out nakedly, and the people around them were even more dumbfounded.
Duan Zeran got angry on the spot, "The Tianjian Sect has gone too far and wants to frame us, so just wait for our revenge. Brothers, do it to them."
Taiyi Sect, as the head of the five major sects in the southern region, has always been proud and arrogant. When had they ever been so angry, everyone was so angry that they drew their swords one after another.
The Tianjian Sect did not expect that things would turn out like this, but facing the irritable Duan Zeran and the Taiyi Sect's anger, they could not defend themselves except to deal with it.
Before the treasure hunt even begins, an inexplicable battle ensues.
There was chaos in the forest, the sound of swords, roars, and screams intertwined into a beautiful movement.
Just when the two sects were fighting fiercely, rumbling sounds came, and hundreds of monsters surrounded them in an instant, only a few hundred feet away from them.
"Damn it, it's you, Tianjian Sect, who attracted these monsters."
Duan Zeran was very worried. There were hundreds of them. What should we do?
"Senior brother, stop fighting and take the beast-proof pill quickly."
A Taiyi Sect disciple shouted.
Facing the surging army of monsters, the disciples of both sects were dumbfounded.
It is not easy to destroy so many monsters. The battle will probably last until dark, and by then the real spirits will have an advantage over others.
Many disciples took out the beast-proof pills and prepared to take them.
Duan Zeran also took out the beast-avoiding elixir, and at a glance he saw that Yun Xingluo's aura on the opposite side was completely natural, almost blending into the forest.
Looking at their beast-avoiding elixir, it exudes a strong aura that makes the monsters avoid it.
Duan Zeran finally believed what Yun Xingluo said before, that the Hidden Breath Pill was indeed effective. He shouted, "It can't be used. If you use the True Spirit, it will avoid us."
At the critical moment, Yun Xingluo appeared, holding the Hidden Breath Pill in his hand, "Fellow Taoists of Taiyi Sect, do you need the Hidden Breath Pill?"
There was no time to think about it, Duan Zeran said directly, "How much does one pill cost?"
"One thousand, medium-grade spiritual stone, no negotiation."
"You just sold low-grade spiritual stones for 100 yuan?"
"Just now, now is now, you don't have to buy it."
"Give, give."
It was too late, everyone in Taiyi Sect took out their spiritual stones, quickly bought them, crushed the elixirs, and applied them on their bodies.
In just a moment, the auras of more than thirty people from the Taiyi Sect instantly merged with the forest.
The people of Tianjian Sect were impressed, and Su Xiangqian asked shamelessly, "Are there any more? We want them too."
"Yes, but I won't sell it to you."
Yun Xingluo decisively refused.
Su Qianqian was instantly angry, "Yun Xingluo, you are still not a human being. You set up a trap to frame us. Now you are doing business here at a high price and refuse to sell to us. Do you still have any morals?"
Yun Xingluo looked at Su Xiangxian's shameless look and sneered, "Su Xiangxian, you have time to morally kidnap me here, but you should think about how to deal with the monster in front of you."
At this time, the monster has arrived.
The auras of the people of Taiyi Sect were hidden, and they rushed directly towards the disciples of Tianjian Sect.
"It's all you. Whatever happened, you had to kill Yun Xingluo. It's okay now. You shot yourself in the foot."
Lu Chengzhou was a little irritated. It was not good for Su Xiangqian to offend anyone. She offended the evil star Yun Xingluo, which made them very passive now. He hated this troublemaker to death.
Fortunately, Xiao He was decisive and immediately ordered, "Okay, stop arguing and take the beast-avoiding pill quickly, otherwise it will be too late."
People in the Tianjian Sect are not fools, and they know that they have been cheated.
But now they couldn't afford to waste time, so they took the beast-avoiding pill one after another.
At this time, Yun Xingluo became invisible again and ran away.
